name: You.com
description: You.com web search, content extraction, and research skills for OpenClaw.

apiKey.label: You.com API key
apiKey.help: Falls back to the YDC_API_KEY environment variable when unset.

baseUrl.label: Base URL
baseUrl.help: Only change this for a You.com-compatible gateway.

apiKey.description: You.com API key. Accepts a literal string or a SecretRef. Falls back to YDC_API_KEY.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for You.com REST endpoints. Must be http or https.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout applied to each You.com API request.

crawlTimeoutSeconds.description: Per-page crawl timeout passed through to You.com content extraction.

count.description: Default number of search results requested per query.

safesearch.description: SafeSearch filter level passed through to You.com search.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code passed through to You.com search.

freshness.description: Optional freshness filter passed through to You.com search.

extractionMode.description: Content extraction requested alongside search results.
